precepts.text: The other name is American, black, Negro, Hispanic, Latino, Puerto Rican, Haitian, Papua New Guinean: none of it is in the Bible, and now the Most High woke us up through our leadership to show our people their nationality according to the Bible.
precepts.point: The reason this happened is because we broke God's laws.

note.label: You Are Hated And In Hell

precepts.text: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts. Our people walk after their own thoughts, and their thoughts are the thoughts these man made religions gave them: do not keep any laws. Those vipers hatch eggs, and little vipers come out.
precepts.point: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. See what our people do: they walk after their own thoughts. They don't give a damn what the Bible says; I do what I want to do.

And their thoughts are the white man's thoughts. Our people follow all these man-made religions, and they don't teach God's laws, his commandments, his statutes. We ain't got to keep no laws, because that is what all these white people were teaching: don't keep no laws.

So what do you get? Those vipers hatch eggs, and what comes out? Little vipers, little snakes. Your son, little Tyrone, is a snake, and your daughter, little Chenique, was a snake too. That is what God is saying in Isaiah 59:5, and it is why verse 7 says “their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity”: a rebellious people walking after their own thoughts.

precepts.text: Found of them that sought me not, a nation not called by my name; a rebellious people walking after their own thoughts in Christianity and Islam, sacrificing in gardens, eating swine's flesh and broth of abominable things, and saying stand by thyself, I am holier than thou, washed in the blood: a smoke in his nose.
precepts.point: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity, Miss Laura included, and all that prey upon thee shall be a prey. For I will restore health unto thee: only the Lord heals, by Christ's stripes, for they that are whole need no physician and he came to call sinners to repentance. Because they call thee an outcast, African-American, Haitian, Jamaican, this is Zion whom no man seeketh after.
precepts.why:
This goes with Christ saying he came not for the righteous but for sinners. “I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not”. Like the disciples, we didn't wake up one day as kids searching for the Lord of heaven and earth. The word was introduced to us and woke us up.

“I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.” We are called African-Americans, Haitians, Jamaicans, Puerto Ricans. That is a nation not called by his name.

“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. We are that rebellious people, walking in Christianity and Islam, our people following their own thoughts in these religions. “A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick”: the churches and mosques. Then: “which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels”. You know that's the church: there was always a swine fest at the end, pig feet and all of that; possum soup, turtle soup.

“Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou.” That is what the churches say to the Israelites on the street preaching: stand by yourself, I don't need no black Jesus, I'm washed in the blood of Jesus, I'm water baptized, I'm holier than thou. “These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.” God can't stand them.

That is the people Jeremiah calls an Outcast, “This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.” Those who think they are whole push away the physician; the sick who admit it are the ones he heals.

precepts.text: Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen, and he shall call his servants by another name.
precepts.point: Israel became an astonishment, a proverb and a byword, called by names other than the one God gave. Israel means prince with God; there is no greater name.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 28:37 says Israel would become “an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations”: called by names outside of our God-given name. God gave us a name. Israel means prince of the power with God, and there is no mightier name on the face of the earth. Why would you want to call yourself a Latinized negro, a Latino? That is a racist term. You have to do the history and get the knowledge; you have to find yourself so you don't lose yourself.

Isaiah 65:15 says the same: “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen.” We left the name Israel for a curse, for racist terms like Latino, Hispanic, and names like Cuban, Colombian, Venezuelan, Dominican. Yet it is “unto my chosen”: we are God's chosen people. You have to see the greatness in who you are. We have fallen so far that we think we can't come out of it, but we are coming out, because there is a God.

“for the Lord God shall slay thee”. For wanting a king of another nation over us, for wanting to assimilate, the Most High slew us and caused the basest of men to rule over us. “and call his servants by another name”: now we are called Latino, blacks, spics, wetbacks, illegal aliens. That is why we do not know who we are, a confusion of faces. We are searching, but we are not searching the scriptures.

So-called Latinos, you are the Israelites. Latino is not your given name; your name is Israel, the twelve tribes of Israel. You think this is a black movement, a negro movement, but the twelve tribes of Israel are mainly so-called Latinos. We have to get back to our history and our true nationality.

precepts.text: Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen; we became a byword and lost our name in the captivity.
precepts.point: Thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all nations: Puerto Rican, Dominican, Haitian, Jamaican, African American, gentile. We lost our name and left it for a curse, like it says in Isaiah, while others wear the name and cry anti-Semitic.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

precepts.why:
“The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone. And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.” Puerto Rican, Dominican, Haitian, Jamaican, African American, gentile: those are the bywords. We lost our name in the captivity.

Isaiah says how: “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name”. We left our name for a curse and became a byword among the nations, while others wear the name and cry anti-Semitic. Carried to a nation our fathers never knew, serving other gods of wood and stone, called by every name but our own: that is what becoming a proverb and a byword looks like.

precepts.text: His servants who keep His commandments shall eat, drink, and rejoice, but those who refuse the truth shall be hungry, thirsty, and ashamed.
precepts.point: He shall visit his habitation and not sin. Peace and security come to the man the Most High keeps.

note.label: Job 5: The Most High Corrects and Delivers His Righteous

precepts.why:
“At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.” The Lord shows who laughs at famine: “Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed”.

His servants who keep his commandments shall eat, drink, and rejoice, but those who refuse the truth shall be hungry, thirsty, and ashamed. The beasts of the earth point to the zoonosis of these days, Ebola, coronavirus, and the sicknesses created from splitting genes, and the righteous stay strong and steadfast in his truth. Peace and security come to the man the Most High keeps: his tabernacle is in peace, and he visits his habitation and does not sin.

precepts.text: Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen, for the Lord shall slay thee and call his servants by another name; our names were left for a curse in slavery.
precepts.point: This is prophecy of our name being changed back: on the sabbath classes a member is announced no longer a Corinthian or an Ephesian, because they take a pen and legalize their name change, subscribing with the hand as the scripture said.

note.label: Isaiah 44: The Idol Maker's Folly and the Changed Name

precepts.why:
“One shall say, I am the Lord’s; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.” This is prophecy of our name being changed back, and Isaiah 65 shows how it was lost: “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name”.

Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen, for the Lord shall slay thee and call his servants by another name. Our names were left for a curse in slavery. So when the Most High pours his spirit upon Jacob’s seed and his blessing upon his offspring, they surname themselves by the name of Israel again. On the sabbath classes a member is announced no longer a Corinthian or an Ephesian, because they take a pen and legalize their name change, subscribing with the hand as the scripture said.

precepts.text: "I am found of them that sought me not," the northern kingdom that began to seek him.
precepts.point: The restoration is two sticks made one nation. Ephraim, once "not a people," is called back and named the sons of the living God, having obtained mercy that they had not obtained, so the Gentiles being brought in are the outcasts of Israel that Christ came to be a light to.

note.label: Acts 10: Cornelius and the Northern Kingdom Grafted In

precepts.why:
“I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.”

That is the northern kingdom, which began to seek him. Ephraim was “not a people”, a nation no longer called by his name, and still he was found of them.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why: The angel cast the prayers of the saints into the earth, and there were voices, thunderings, lightnings and an earthquake: that is going into our prayers being answered immediately. Sometimes you pray and it seems like the Lord doesn't answer; it is like he ain't listening. But there is going to come a day, and Isaiah prophesies this thing right here. “And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.” That right there is evidence: that day, when Raphael takes the prayers of the saints and casts them to the earth, our prayer is going to be answered immediately. We are in the midst of speaking and the Lord is going to say, I'm answering that already. Can't you wait for that day?

In the coming kingdom: “And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.” The communication will be open for us with the Most High and his Son. You have a thought, and he already knows it.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 21 Thy Kingdom Come

precepts.why: What Isaiah prophesied. “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth”: that’s what we just read in Revelation 21:1. “I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy”: the Lord is going to change everything. “The voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her”: ain’t going to be no more stillbirths, no more miscarriages. “The child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed”: this goes with the other nations and those of our people that’s not part of that first resurrection. “They shall not build, and another inhabit”: those days of captivity ain’t happening no more. “Before they call, I will answer”: you think he don’t listen; on this day he said before they call I will answer. “The wolf and the lamb shall feed together”: that’s how you know this is the kingdom. Moses said the Lord will remove all evil beasts out of the land, so he is going to change the whole nature. “They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain”: the other nations are going to be at their very lowest state.
